'''SV-3 Eradicator''' was a prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that participated in the [[Battle of the Red Reaper]]. Used to defend the bridge of the [[Red Reaper]] against capture, the prototype droid's weapons were augmented by six mysterious [[Sith power source]]s. When aligned properly, the power sources were able to boost the droids' weapon capability to a degree wherein a single strike could kill a person. This ability was to no avail as the droid was destroyed during the Battle of the Red Reaper.<ref name="Red Reaper" />
